productInput.title: 24-Piece Drawer Organizer Tray Set
productInput.descriptionHtml:
Bring order to crowded drawers with a modular 24-piece organizer set designed for tools, office supplies, craft materials, cosmetics, and everyday small items. The separate trays can be arranged side by side so frequently used pieces stay visible and easy to reach instead of shifting into one mixed pile.

This set includes six small trays, fourteen medium trays, and four large trays. Use the sizes together in a wide drawer or divide them between several work areas. The low-profile shape helps make practical use of drawer space while keeping different item types separated.

Each tray is made from PP plastic and can be moved independently when your storage needs change. The smooth, open design makes it easy to see contents at a glance and wipe the surfaces clean with a soft damp cloth. Trays may be used in a toolbox, desk, bathroom vanity, kitchen utility drawer, hobby station, or garage cabinet.

Measure the inside of your drawer before ordering and compare it with the tray dimensions below. Colors may appear slightly different because of lighting and screen settings. Small accessories shown in lifestyle images are not included.

  • Tray mix: 6 small, 14 medium, 4 large
  • Small tray: approximately 3 � 3 � 1.8 inches
  • Medium tray: approximately 6 � 3 � 1.8 inches
  • Large tray: approximately 9 � 6 � 1.8 inches
  • Material: PP plastic
  • Care: wipe clean with a soft damp cloth

productInput.title: 50 kg Pocket Luggage Scale
productInput.descriptionHtml:
Skip the airport-scale surprise. Pocket Luggage Scale is a compact hanging scale made for a quick weight check before you leave, whether you are weighing a suitcase, a carry-on, a shopping bag, or outdoor gear. Clip the strap or hook to your item, lift steadily, and read the measurement on the LCD display.

Its small, travel-friendly shape is easy to keep in a drawer, backpack, or packing cube. The scale supports kilograms, grams, pounds, and ounces, with a tare function for weighing a bag or container first. A data-hold function keeps the final reading visible briefly after lifting, making it easier to check the number without juggling your luggage.

Use it as a convenient planning tool before travel, not as a substitute for an airline's official baggage scale. For best results, place a CR2032 battery in the unit before use and hold the item securely while measuring. Battery is not included.

  • Maximum capacity: 50 kg / 110 lb
  • Resolution: 10 g
  • LCD display with kg, g, lb, and oz units
  • Tare and data-hold functions
  • Requires 1 CR2032 battery (not included)
  • Includes scale and user manual

productInput.title: Black Double-Layer Cable Organizer Case
productInput.descriptionHtml:
Keep charging accessories together with a double-layer cable organizer case made for travel, commuting, and everyday storage. The structured zippered format gives cables, adapters, memory cards, and other small electronics a dedicated place instead of leaving them loose in a backpack or drawer.

Two storage levels help separate frequently used pieces from backup accessories. Use the internal sections for compatible cords and compact devices, then close the zipper before placing the case inside luggage or a work bag. The selected Black option is easy to pair with other travel gear.

The nylon exterior is intended for ordinary handling and organization. This listing does not promise full waterproof protection, so keep the case away from prolonged moisture and do not use it as protective equipment for fragile electronics. Switch devices off before packing them and avoid storing loose batteries or damaged cables.

Approximate exterior size is 19 � 11 � 5.5 cm (7.5 � 4.3 � 2.2 in). Compare these dimensions with your accessories before ordering. Cables, chargers, and electronics shown in lifestyle images are not included. Wipe the exterior gently and allow it to dry completely before storage.

productInput.title: White Small Wheeled Under-Sink Organizer Bin
productInput.descriptionHtml:
Bring order to a hard-to-use cabinet area with this wheeled under-sink organizer bin. It keeps small household items together instead of leaving them loose around pipes or at the back of a cupboard. The low bin and built-in wheels make it easier to pull frequently used supplies forward when you need them.

Use the organizer for items that suit your cabinet and routine, such as cleaning cloths, sponges, brushes, bottles, or other everyday essentials. Grouping related items in one place helps you see what is available before buying replacements. The open top keeps contents visible and allows quick access without a lid.

Before placing the bin under a sink, measure the available height, width, and depth. Confirm that plumbing, hinges, or cabinet hardware will not block its movement. Position heavier items securely, keep household chemicals closed, follow their labels, and store them away from children and pets.

The plastic surface can be wiped with a soft damp cloth. Use the organizer only on a stable cabinet surface and do not overload it. Small accessories and bottles shown in lifestyle images are not included.

productInput.title: White Five-Slot Cable Organizer Strip
productInput.descriptionHtml:
Guide everyday cords into a consistent position with a compact five-slot cable organizer strip. It is designed for compatible charging, mouse, keyboard, and earphone cables that otherwise slide behind a desk or become tangled around a work surface.

Clean and dry the mounting area before installation, then press the organizer firmly onto a smooth, suitable surface. Adhesion varies with surface texture, finish, temperature, and handling. Avoid delicate, porous, dusty, or recently painted surfaces, and remove slowly to reduce the risk of finish damage.

The selected White five-slot configuration is the only option offered on this listing. The organizer is approximately 8.5 � 4 cm, with slots about 0.7 cm wide. Compare these measurements with your cables before ordering. Cables and electronics shown in images are not included.

  • Placement: smooth, clean surfaces

The reusable metal design is simple to operate and easy to store in a bathroom drawer or toiletry kit. Use only with flexible tubes that fit the slot without force. It is not intended for rigid containers, pressurized packaging, medication dosing, or industrial use.
